notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Yes the game is still getting updates, I am also thinking about a large content update currently. This one is just bug fixes. 

fixed a bug that would trigger blob without the blob being on screen
fixed a bug that would prevent water from turning into ice
fixed a bug that would turn any objects interacting with the electron objects into the wrong object
general stability updates

notes.title: Bug fixes and new steam sdk
notes.notes:
Fixed a minor bug and updated to a newer steam SDK. Thanks to user Ham Sandwich for making me aware of the bug. The build took a long time to release and fix as Game Maker 2 which physics cake is made in, released an update that broke all the integrated steam functions and forced you to update to using a new extension. This took a bit to implement as they removed the old way of doing things and just broke my game from compiling. Everything is fixed now and updates will resume. 

There was also an issue with the ice object making water turn into the blob for no reason, which has since been fixed.

notes.title: Build 35 Update
notes.notes: I added the ability to pause physics at any time, you can do it while building things, before, or during. It is fun and allows for more creativity.

notes.title: MASSIVE coming update
notes.notes:
Since the Mac version was scrapped due to issues with Apple's code signing requirements and issues with running the game on the newest macs with the M1 chips, we have been planning on where to take the current version of the game. I am excited to announce that currently in development there is now a selection room with different sandboxes full of new and different objects to choose from. This does not mean the current mostly finished sandbox 1 (the current main physics environment) will stop getting updates and more object interactions as I am actively working on those and there will be new ones in the next update. 

This also means that there will probably be some of the previous objects that were scrapped for not fitting in with the mostly organic theme of the first physics environment. So things that were never released will probably be repurposed. 

The debug room will also be easier to access. 

I apologize for the lack of updates and lack of news about the direction for the game, but we all wanted to make sure that there was a clear roadmap going forwards. As soon as there is a decent amount of objects in the new sandbox room, you can expect an update!

notes.title: Mac Version Cancelled
notes.notes: We were able to build a mac version, but due to their policies on code signing and the fact you have to have certain mac hardware to build for mac, we have decided to cancel our mac build of the game due to us being uncertain with how developing for mac will look in the future and differences for mac based on their new m1 chip. We are going to see what we can take from the mac version to make the current windows build of the game even better.

notes.title: Update Progress
notes.notes:
The current update has been delayed as I did not like one of the new features I had a plan on adding that took several weeks to implement. I decided it was not up to my standards. I may try to rework it. 

I also scrapped 3 different new objects as they just did not fit well with the other current in-game objects. 

Also, we recently got a mac for our development office and are hard at work getting things set up for a mac build of the game. 

We apologize for the lack of new content and still being in early access, however, we are doing our best to make sure we maintain quality and listen to everyone's feedback.

notes.title: Build 29 Update
notes.notes:
- made achievements for initial object creation less spammy. Each object now requires more than one to be spawned. (still a very low number, in this case, it is 25 for water and 5 for the water spawner), but semi-random across objects in order to cut down on how many achievements are triggered in rapid succession. All achievements are still easy to unlock this way and fast to unlock, to satisfy achievement hunters, but not annoy first-time users as much. 

- made the drag-up object no longer use physics so it still functions the same but no longer takes up a physics slot. made the upwards drag more fluid and less jerky.

- Revised the achievements on steams side to show which ones trigger via the debug room.

- added the workout, juggle, vomit, eat jello, shocking, frozen, burned, and drowned achievements for the stick figure. 

- None of the spawners take up physics slots now and are all nonphysical. This is possible since the only thing they needed to collide with before was the deleted object, and the deleted object can now clean up nonphysical objects. 

- Reduced the spawn time for the water spawner by half so you do not need to use as many of them as before. This is possible due to physics engine enhancements. 

- Reduced the spawn time for the oil spawner by half so you do not need to use as many of them as before. This is possible due to physics engine enhancements. 

- Reduced the spawn time for the jello spawner by half so you do not need to use as many of them as before. This is possible due to physics engine enhancements. 

- Reduced the spawn time for the ice spawner by half so you do not need to use as many of them as before. This is possible due to physics engine enhancements. 

- Reduced the spawn time for the electron spawner by half so you do not need to use as many of them as before. This is possible due to physics engine enhancements. 

- Removed the old debug room and replaced it with the new updated one that is not a mess.

- Removed copies of the original game rooms that were small-sized with the old aspect ratio as they took up memory and were not able to be accessed by the user and will never be used again. 

The new object(s) I was testing to add to this update that caused the delay got scrapped as they were not up to my standards. I will be working to implement more objects and interactions in the future that will hopefully meet my standards.

notes.title: Update Progress
notes.notes:
So previous updates have been a lot faster to come out. This one has been about a month since the last large update. I wanted to let everyone know I am working on it. It is taking a long time as I am making adjustments to the physics engine itself and that is making the game a lot more stable and that means more objects can be on screen at once with less lag, and I will be able to add more objects and interactions into the game. I also was addressing some of the comments in negative reviews, as criticism is an opportunity for growth. 

One of the things I hear a lot is the achievements triggering so often can be annoying. So in the coming update, I made them less spammy, but making the minimum object sawn counts higher. This way people who are achievement hunters can still get all their achievements quickly, but users who don't care about achievements as much will not be bothered by them. 

I am also currently working on a new object for the game as well as more object interactions, however, those are progressing slowly as they require a lot more work than some of the more simple interactions like burning wood. 

I am also planning to eventually do mac and maybe Linux releases as well.

notes.title: Build 20 - RELEASE UPDATE
notes.notes:
This is the final main bug clean-up and polish before we release it to the general public on steam. We will continue to do more polish after release before we drop new features. 

Build 20
- Reduced collision checks for the clacker balls and jello objects using parenting.
- Cut out a redundant state in grass that fixes an issue with loading and removes an unneeded collision group.
- Grass now stops growing if you delete or burn the root it grows from.
- Reduced the overhead for the wood-burning object. It is now just one object with 4 sprite states and particle states instead of 4 objects with 4 sprite states and 4 particle states. Putting out burning wood with water now also puts out the particles. They will restart when set on fire again.
- Since a lot of separate object states have been cut out, saving and loading is a lot faster.
- Since a lot of separate object states have been cut out, the game now crashes much less.
- removed the last jello state as it was blurry and still too many states, thus causing lag and instability when there was a ton of junk on the screen.

notes.title: Beta Build 18 - Large Update
notes.notes:
Build 18
- Removed the last jello size state as it was blurry and caused lag.
- Cleaned up jello expansion code.
- Added drag click to jello, it is a bit wonky but works currently.
- Fixed an issue with jello where it had two physical collision groups. One for the parent object and one for each individual cube. The one for the parent object was removed. 
- Reduced the number of events needed when jello is shrunk by fire. This reduces physics engine lag when jello is shrunk by fire.
- Reduced the number of events needed when the wood is burned by fire. This reduces the lag between burn events.
- The one key now triggers single spawn.
- The two key now triggers multi-spawn.
- Steam cloud now works and backs up your last save to the cloud.
- The limit for the sticky object is now 400.
- Added the missing maroon line object picker.
- Colored lines now save and load correctly.
- Spawner objects now use parenting for the same collision group when colliding with the delete object, this reduces collision lag
- Spinners now use parenting to reduce collision lag.
- The collision check for objects hitting the spinner was moved to the spinner instead of each object, as there are probably more objects than spinner objects on screen at any given time.
- Growing grass will now stop growing if fps dips under 5 and will resume growing at a random interval between 1 and 15 seconds. This greatly reduces lag when a ton of grass is growing.
- Removed the copy secondary fire object that the oil would spawn when set on fire. It now spawns the standard fire object instead. This reduces the number of assets and collision groups on screen. This also lets things that touch fire spawned by oil also catch fire themselves. The spawned fire also responds better under lag now as it inherits the main fire objects lag check. 
- Fire burn time reduced to 20 in-game frame steps instead of 25, fire will despawn faster under lag.
- Instead of triggering lag protection, if an object is triggered to spawn a fire object, it will wait 1 to 2 seconds to change. This reduces lag greatly. 
- Steam no longer gets stuck on fire objects and passes through them as intended.

notes.title: Build History & Pre-release updates log
notes.notes:
Notes for all builds before the steam page launched publically.

build 2 and 3

- used parenting for fire objects to reduce the number of function calls to stop lag and in extreme cases some crashes. 
- made void not die as a result of lag check under 5 fps
- make the fire object have more of a trail
- steam screenshots functions are now supported
- removed 4 steps out of the jello transforms that are not noticeable but cut down on lag and engine crashes
- made the lag check not remove void since it is a static object on its own and does not contribute to collision lag
- fixed an issue with ice falling through the burning wood tiles
- greatly reduced collision lag for wood and burning objects
- reduced save / load times slightly

build 4

- increased the time between object spawns slightly for all the spawners
- the steam spawners are now more steam-stack like
- the number of steam spawners that can be on screen without lagging the physics engine has now drastically increased
- reduced collision lag for the spinner objects
- reduced collision lag further for the jello objects
- took out redundant collision checks
- made the jello cubes snap better to the sticky object
- cut down on redundant calls to form joints between the sticky object and the jello objects
- sticky objects can now have more than 10 jello cubes stick to it
- sticky objects can now have more than 10 water objects stick to it
- greatly reduced collision lag for grass when colliding with jello objects

build 5 & 6

- added drag and drop by holding down right-click for most physical objects (does not affect jello cubes or electrons currently)
- water has a built-in overlay check, just water for the cheevo for when coming soon drops

build 7 

- More achievements added
- Stability improvements
